chirp_pacing.definition: jitter lateness = time.monotonic_ns() just before sendto - (frame first_send_ns + chirp*gap); total lateness adds frame start lateness (first_send_ns - intended_ns); sender-side only, not wire/board arrival spacing
chirp_pacing.rule: valid = jitter P99 < p99 limit and total max < 10% of period (2026-11-26 user decision); frame-boundary overrun_frames is reported, not a validity condition in paced mode
